name: Raw Card Data Prohibited
description: NEXT F commerce storage, logs, events and generic schemas must never store raw PAN or CVV payment-card data.
purpose: NEXT F commerce storage, logs, events and generic schemas must never store raw PAN or CVV payment-card data.

requirements.description: NEXT F commerce storage, logs, events and generic schemas must never store raw PAN or CVV payment-card data.
The rule must be evaluated from authoritative server-side state and must not trust browser-calculated or provider-reported state without required validation/reconciliation.

failure.notes: Phase 12 defines the domain error identifier. HTTP mapping and response envelopes are reserved for Phase 18.

relationships.description: This rule constrains commerce.payment operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.paymentMethodReference operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.checkoutPaymentSelection operations or state.

valid: An operation involving commerce.payment, commerce.paymentMethodReference satisfies the rule before authoritative state is committed.
invalid: An implementation bypasses commerce.rule.rawCardDataProhibited and commits a conflicting or unverifiable state.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
Use canonical Phase 11 schemas as the data model; do not create shadow transaction models.
If provider behavior differs, translate through an adapter and reconcile to canonical NEXT F state.
